target: full custom Excel language and runtime coverage
scope: every entry of the pinned Microsoft inventory, not every possible formula expression or UDF
udfs: arbitrary add-ins/UDFs are in long-term scope through explicit typed bindings; not enumerable built-ins

grammar_features.definition: A bounded rectangular formula result whose row and column shape is preserved by evaluate_result, including arrays selected by IF, IFERROR, IFNA, IFS, and SWITCH.
grammar_features.boundary: This value does not project into worksheet spill cells; grid placement, blockers, A1# and implicit intersection remain catalogued only.

grammar_features.definition: Six scalar comparison operators with explicit number < text < Boolean ranking, counterpart-typed blank adaptation, left error propagation and finite binary64 numeric comparisons. ASCII text is case-insensitive; non-ASCII uses an explicit exact UTF-8 ordinal local profile.
grammar_features.boundary: Excel-targeted type/blank cases remain unobserved; primary operator/precedence documentation and compatible MATCH ordering do not establish every coercion/collation case. Native primitives retain their separate legacy comparison contract.

grammar_evidence_note: existing catalog statuses, not newly verified translation coverage
reference_evidence_note: fixture expected values include documented examples, independent arithmetic and local profiles; case membership or engine agreement is not an Excel oracle

source_translation.average_direct_policy: provisional; primary sources conflict; no Excel observation
source_translation.error_scope: nine existing scalar codes; modern service/security/Python/provider error contracts remain planned
source_translation.subset: multiple sheets, + - * /, SUM/AVERAGE ranges, lazy IF/IFERROR, XLOOKUP with exact one-dimensional reference arrays and forward/reverse search, six typed comparison operators, mixed/absolute/quoted references and nine typed scalar errors; numeric-v1 and graph-v2 through graph-v6 remain supported
source_translation.arbitrary_source_programs: refused outside versioned scaffold; no restoration of embedded XML
